figure_visual_review: Both versions inspected; final render02 has readable labels, complete domains, improved cloud contrast and no annotation/boundary overlap.
numerical_scope: Finite numerical validation only. Sixteen of 256 trajectories replayed in full; all batch concatenations, period tests and closest-normalization states checked. Independent full-site expression and AD derivatives checked at 640 states; no asymptotic or basin-volume conclusion.
certificate_scope: Exact rational Krawczyk and finite-distance checks, frozen-source replays, and exact inclusion of the central singularity in the rejected proposed grid. Does not exclude every smaller trapping region or classify the asymptotic numerical regime.
